/: Tufanganj Vivekananda Vidyalaya (H.S.), also spelt Tufanganj Vivekanand Vidyalaya and known as TVV, is a higher secondary school in Tufanganj, Cooch Behar, West Bengal. Since 1964 it has taught Class V to XII, with Science and Arts streams in Class XI and XII under the West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education.

Parents and students can read the latest school notices, send an online admission enquiry, meet the teachers, see results and achievements, look at the campus, events and photo gallery, download school forms, get the TVV School app, and log in to the student and staff portal.
In Bengali the school's name is তুফানগঞ্জ বিবেকানন্দ বিদ্যালয়।
/about: Tufanganj Vivekananda Vidyalaya (H.S.) was established in 1964 in Tufanganj, Cooch Behar, West Bengal. It is a higher secondary school that teaches Class V to Class XII, so a child can complete the whole school journey in one place. From Class XI students choose the Science or the Arts stream.
The school is named after Swami Vivekananda. Its motto is Knowledge · Character · Progress. It is also written Tufanganj Vivekanand Vidyalaya and called TVV.
/admissions: How to join Tufanganj Vivekananda Vidyalaya (H.S.): send an admission enquiry using the online form — student's name, guardian's contact number and the class — or contact the school office directly. The usual steps are to collect the prospectus, submit the application with the previous mark-sheet, and attend a short interview. Ask the office for the current dates.
Class V to XII are taught here, with Science and Arts streams in Class XI and XII.
/academics: Academics at Tufanganj Vivekananda Vidyalaya (H.S.), Tufanganj, Cooch Behar. Classes V to X follow the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education; in Class XI and XII students choose the Science or the Arts stream under the West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education.
Science covers Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, English and Environmental Science. Arts covers History, Geography, Philosophy, Political Science, Sanskrit, Bangla and English.
